claims.statement: All five repaired radial modes have 40 nonzero derivative-jump shells; both l=1 modes also have a nonzero linear origin coefficient. Individual columns have no full strong L2 Coulomb residual.
All five exact archived radial modes have nonzero value jumps; global H1 closeness and strong differentiability of translated archived frame may not be presumed.
Duhamel comparison in two time-dependent finite metrics retains both compatibility defects and a common-L2 embedding error, with a computable covector residual B.
